source: build a game where Puma logos are used in full map and on the racing boarding ads make a racing game

image_prompt.text: Trackside guardrails and advertising hoardings running the length of the circuit, carrying Puma boards where they face the racing line
Curved track elements bringing the circuit cleanly back on itself for the next lap
A wide starting grid of evenly spaced slots across the track so racers launch side by side

layout_placement.text: Grid slots on the start straight, spaced so racers do not collide on launch
Lap detection across the start-finish line plus split points at the major turns

notes: Circuit was chosen over point-to-point because trackside advertising boarding implies a spectated closed course; the prompt never says lap or finish line, so this was a close call.
The branding requirement covers the full map - terrain and track surface as well as the boards - and is a global dressing rule the emitted block has no field for.

open_questions.ask: What kind of circuit - a street course, a desert track, a stylized kart circuit?
How many laps, and is this cars, karts, or racing on foot?

coverage_missing.ask: What setting should the circuit sit in?
Lap count, and what the player drives?
A closed lap circuit or a point-to-point course?

answers.ask: What kind of circuit - a street course, a desert track, a stylized kart circuit?
answers.answer: Use a small stylized kart circuit, with Puma logos placed throughout the map and on trackside racing boards.

answers.ask: How many laps, and is this cars, karts, or racing on foot?
answers.answer: Make it kart racing with 3 laps per race.
